Based on the information provided, the HepaProtect vaccine has an efficacy of 95% in preventing Hepatitis B infection specifically in healthy individuals aged 18 to 55. The text does not provide efficacy data for other age groups or health conditions, so its suitability for those populations cannot be determined from this content alone. However, it is explicitly unsuitable for individuals with a history of severe allergies to yeast or any component of the vaccine.
